Bottomless Brunch London: Samba Brunch in Paddington | Ayllu
Samba Bottomless Brunch in Paddington

Bottomless brunch in London is everywhere: unlimited prosecco, a fixed menu, ninety minutes, next table please. Most of them are interchangeable. Ayllu's is not. Every Saturday and Sunday in Paddington Central we run a ninety-minute Samba Bottomless Brunch: unlimited Nikkei Japanese-Peruvian sharing plates, free-flowing drinks and a live Samba show. If you are looking for the best bottomless brunc
What's Included in Ayllu's Bottomless Brunch

Two packages, both running for ninety minutes. £37pp is bottomless food only: unlimited Nikkei sharing plates for the full sitting, ceviche, sushi uramaki rolls, appetisers, mains and dessert, all designed to share. £55pp is bottomless food and drinks: everything above plus free-flowing drinks for the full session. Choose from house white wine, house red wine, prosecco or the cocktail of the week.
Book · Samba Brunch: Bottomless Food
Book · Brunch: Bottomless Food & Drinks

Three times every brunch, Ayllu's Samba dancers take the floor, each performance running fifteen minutes, with a DJ playing throughout. Bottomless brunch here is a party, not a production line. It is food, drinks, music and colour in one room on the Paddington canalside. Read more… Samba dancers take the floor three times every brunch.

Where most bottomless brunches settle for eggs and fizz, Ayllu serves its full Nikkei kitchen: bright ceviche, uramaki rolls, robata skewers and mains, finished with dessert. Vegetarian and vegan options are available. This is a bottomless brunch built around the food first and the drinks second. Read more…

Served every Saturday (11am to 4pm) and Sunday (12pm to 4pm). Last booking is at 3:15pm. Bottomless food and drinks start from your booked reservation time, so arrive on time to get the full ninety minutes. Ayllu is at 25 Sheldon Square, Paddington Central, London W2 6EY, minutes from Paddington Station. Book a table to secure your slot. Read more…

Please note that your seating will be in either the main Ayllu restaurant area or the Regent Room, depending on availability. While we can't guarantee a specific area, both spaces offer the same fantastic bottomless experience and samba entertainment.
How much is bottomless brunch at Ayllu?
£37 per person for bottomless food, or £55 per person for bottomless food and drinks.
When is bottomless brunch served?
